title: Multi-Asset Portfolio Rebalancing via Risk Parity
description: Three-asset portfolio (ETH/WBTC/USDC) needs rebalancing to risk-weighted target allocation using 90-day historical volatility.

objective.description: Optimize portfolio allocation using risk-weighted target weights based on historical volatility for capital efficiency
constraints: Total gas cost must not exceed $100

scenario: Your portfolio contains 20 ETH ($2,950 each), 2 WBTC ($63,500 each), and 100,000 USDC. Total portfolio: $286,000. Current allocation: ETH 20.6% ($59,000), WBTC 44.4% ($127,000), USDC 35.0% ($100,000). Using historical 90-day volatility (ETH: 68% annualized, WBTC: 52% annualized, USDC: 0.5%), the optimized risk-parity target is: ETH 20% ($57,200), WBTC 30% ($85,800), USDC 50% ($143,000). Rebalance by selling overweight assets on Uniswap V3. ETH/USDC 0.30% pool has $450M TVL; WBTC/USDC 0.30% pool has $180M TVL. Both swaps should have minimal slippage under 0.05%. Rebalance within 5 transactions.

solution.action: Fetch current prices and compute portfolio allocation vs risk-weighted targets
Sell 0.649 WBTC for USDC on Uniswap V3 (0.30% fee tier)
solution.rationale: Largest deviation: WBTC must drop from $127k to $85.8k. Sell 0.649 WBTC. Estimated receive: 0.649 * 63500 * (1 - 0.003 - 0.0004) = $41,131. WBTC position now: 1.351 WBTC ($85,788). USDC position: $141,131.

solution.action: Sell 0.61 ETH for USDC on Uniswap V3 (0.30% fee tier)
solution.rationale: ETH must drop from $59k to $57.2k. Sell 0.61 ETH. Estimated receive: 0.61 * 2950 * (1 - 0.003 - 0.0002) = $1,794. ETH position now: 19.39 ETH ($57,200). USDC position: $142,925.
Post-rebalance: ETH 19.39 ($57,200 = 20.0%), WBTC 1.351 ($85,788 = 30.0%), USDC ~$142,925 (50.0%). Total: $285,913. All within 0.05% of target allocation. Verify gas costs under $100.

alternatives.steps: Use DEX aggregator to sell both WBTC and ETH in one multi-hop transaction for better price and lower total gas
alternatives.tradeoff: Slightly more complex to set up but saves ~$15-20 in gas by combining two swaps

alternatives.steps: Sell only 0.649 WBTC to USDC. Leave ETH position unchanged.
alternatives.tradeoff: ETH would remain at 20.6% vs 20% target (0.6% tracking error) but saves one swap's gas (~$15-25)

risk_flags: WBTC and ETH are highly correlated (0.82), reducing diversification benefit
Historical volatility may not predict future volatility — model risk in risk-parity weights
If ETH or WBTC rallies immediately after selling, portfolio may underperform a buy-and-hold strategy
Low float on WBTC/USDC pool could cause higher than estimated slippage during volatile periods

verification.reason: Risk-parity rebalancing reduces concentrated crypto exposure (from 64% to 50% in volatile assets) and increases stablecoins to 50%, consistent with moderate risk tolerance and 20% max drawdown

reasoning: Step 1: Fetch prices from oracle: ETH=$2950, WBTC=$63500, USDC=$1.001
Step 2: Compute current portfolio value and % allocation from wallet balances
Step 3: Retrieve 90d historical vol from KG node Asset:Volatility for each asset
Step 4: Compute risk-parity targets: weight_i = (1/vol_i) / sum(1/vol_j), then scale to match risk tolerance constraints
Step 5: Compute trade quantities: target_amount - current_amount for each asset
edge_cases: Agent might confuse WBTC with BTCB or renBTC and propose incorrect token contract interactions
Agent might claim Uniswap V3 does not support WBTC/USDC — the pool exists with $180M+ TVL
Agent might propose using a lending protocol to borrow USDC instead of selling tokens—this would increase leverage, violating constraints
Agent might use 30-day volatility (higher) instead of 90-day, yielding different target weights
Agent might forget that WBTC is an ERC-20 token requiring separate approval before swap

criteria: Post-rebalance ETH allocation within 1% of 20% target
Post-rebalance WBTC allocation within 1% of 30% target
Post-rebalance USDC allocation within 1% of 50% target
All swaps executed on audited DEX (Uniswap V3)

failure_modes: May propose buying more WBTC instead of selling (misreading which asset is overweight)
May confuse WBTC token contract or assume it is the native Bitcoin blockchain token
May miscalculate target weights by misapplying risk-parity formula
May forget to include WBTC ERC-20 approval step before swap
May not consider that ETH and WBTC are highly correlated, leading to suboptimal risk targets
May retrieve stale 30-day vol instead of specified 90-day vol
May retrieve WBTC price from a low-liquidity DEX pair instead of the canonical Uniswap V3 pool
May overestimate pool liquidity if retrieving data from a multi-hop Uniswap V2 pool instead of V3
